text: 4.02 General Provision (i) Application for grant of Advance Authorisation / Special Advance Authorisation for export of Articles of Apparel and Clothing Accessories / Advance Authorisation for Annual Requirement / Duty Free Import Authorisation (DFIA) shall be filed online (digitally signed) by IEC holder to the concerned jurisdictional Regional Authority as per Appendix 1A. Applicant could be either Registered office or Head office or a branch office or a manufacturing unit of the IEC holder. (ii) Applicant shall upload documents as prescribed in ANF 4A, if any, at the time of online filing of application.
